name: conducting-stark-law-analysis
description: Conducts the provider-side operational review or documentation workflow across an arrangement portfolio: a compliance department's review of physician financial arrangements against Stark Law exceptions, as distinct from counsel's opinion. Builds the arrangement inventory and reconciles the master contract list to AP, payroll, rent rolls and gift logs to find leases, medical directorships, call coverage, free space, staff or services and immediate family arrangements; tracks expirations and holdovers; checks signatures and the 90-day writing and signature rule; confirms FMV documentation on file; compares compensation as written, paid and performed using duty logs, timesheets, call logs and lease space and equipment use; tracks 2026 nonmonetary compensation, incidental benefit and limited remuneration limits by calendar year; reviews group practice productivity bonuses and referral-tracking dashboards; assembles escalation to counsel and CMS SRDP facts. Declines backdating. Draft for compliance review.
